Assessment: Dataset consists of real CV–job description pairs. Relevant to the task of CV-to-job matching. ✓
Dataset covers EU geographies with weighting. Underrepresentation risk exists for Eastern European candidates and non-EU educational backgrounds. Documented limitation (see Document 1, Section 5).
Dataset is large (4.2M pairs). Completeness assessed as adequate for the task.
Automated quality filtering applied (deduplication, format normalisation, personally identifiable information removal). Manual spot-checking of 2% of records performed.

Dataset statistics documented by HireFlow in technical documentation annex. Gender distribution: 51% male-presenting / 44% female-presenting / 5% not determinable. Age: median applicant age 31; range 18–72.
